prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1278; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when your insured's vehicle struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this collision and is pursuing a claim for compensation.

Please direct all future communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already made contact with our client, please let us know so that we may address it.

We also request that you provide the policy limits of liability coverage applicable to your insured for this incident. Please confirm the limits in writing within the timeframe required by applicable law.

Finally, we ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle data, telematics information, repair and inspection records, and any other materials in your possession or control. Please ensure that no such materials are altered, discarded, or destroyed while this matter is pending.
